summary: Draganfly Inc. filed a Form 6-K (material change report) announcing a definitive asset purchase agreement to acquire substantially all of Skip Dynamix's drone technology business for up to US$7,525,000. Consideration includes US$2,525,000 cash at closing, US$2,500,000 in Draganfly common shares via a special warrant vesting over one year, and up to US$2,500,000 earn-out in cash/shares based on milestones. Completion, expected in early June 2026, is subject to regulatory and exchange approvals. No board recommendation or advisor named. Watch for regulatory clearance and integration milestones.
